description: List UMD courses on PlanetTerp in alphabetical order, optionally within one department. No login needed.

department.description: Only list courses in this four-letter department, e.g. "CMSC" (default: all departments)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

name: planetterp_list_courses

average_gpa.description: Average GPA across all recorded sections, on a 4.0 scale; null if no grade data

course_number.description: Course number within the department, e.g. "131"

credits.description: Number of credits the course is worth; null if unknown

description.description: Catalog description of the course, which may contain HTML tags; null if none

professors.description: Names of professors who have taught this course; a name repeats once per section taught

reviews.description: Student reviews of professors, written for this course

course.description: Course code the review was written for, e.g. "CMSC131"; null if it was not tied to a course

created.description: When the review was posted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

expected_grade.description: Grade the student expected, e.g. "A", "B+"; empty string if not given

professor.description: Name of the professor the review is about

rating.description: Star rating the student gave, from 1 to 5

review.description: Full text of the student review

title.description: Course title, e.g. "Object-Oriented Programming I"; null if unknown

title: List courses
